html:
The Gangalidda, also called Yukulta, are an Aboriginal people of the southern coast of the Gulf of Carpentaria in Queensland, around present day Burketown.

Their neighbours were the Garawa to the west, the Waanyi inland and the Lardil and Kaiadilt peoples of the islands offshore, whose languages are related to theirs. They lived from the sea, the mangroves and the rivers that cross the coastal flats.

From the 1860s cattle runs and the port of Burketown brought settlers and violence to the Gulf. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Gangalidda, also called Yukulta, are an Aboriginal people of the southern coast of the Gulf of Carpentaria in Queensland, around present day Burketown.
